fields.title: Flywheel Energy Storage & AC Generation Systems
fields.description:
### Master Flywheel Energy Storage & AC Generation

This course teaches you how to build a soundless, fossil-fuel-free power system using a battery, DC motor, flywheel, and AC generator.

Based on real-world innovation from Lagos, Nigeria, this system provides clean, quiet, and sustainable electricity.

### What You'll Learn
- How flywheels store and release energy
- How to use a DC motor as a generator
- The physics of rotational energy
- How to generate AC power from DC sources
- System assembly, tuning, and maintenance

### Why This Matters
- ✅ No fossil fuels
- ✅ Silent operation
- ✅ Low maintenance
- ✅ Scalable design
- ✅ Made with locally available parts
fields.learning_objectives:
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
1. Explain how flywheel energy storage works
2. Build a motor-generator system
3. Generate AC power from DC batteries
4. Maintain and troubleshoot the system
5. Adapt the design for different power needs
